description: A release has to have been public for 14 days before Renovate proposes it, so a compromised or immediately-yanked publish gets found by someone else before it is offered here.
Security fixes are not delayed by this: Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts defaults are minimumReleaseAge null and prCreation immediate, so a CVE fix is raised straight away.
Nothing automerges. This project has no test suite, so every bump gets a human look and lands through one deploy.
